# Metadata view_hierarchy_definition_search


> [Metadata](../../metadata-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Metadata queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  table_name AS view_name,
  definition AS view_definition,
  LENGTH(definition) AS definition_length
FROM information_schema.views
WHERE
  table_name LIKE 'benchbox_view_%' AND definition LIKE '%benchbox%'
ORDER BY
  table_name
```
